name: San Miguel de Allende
blurb: San Miguel de Allende has appeared in travel conversation only in the last few weeks, from a base of almost nothing. Early posts are enthusiastic but the sample is still small.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
